base_protocol.loss: CD squared divided by R squared; no auxiliary loss
base_protocol.primary_checkpoint: final fixed step/epoch, not training-loss best or unseen-hole selected
base_protocol.target_floor: FPS128 and fixed5 random128 draws from full missing target; reference only, not a learned prediction
base_protocol.purpose: Engineering fit sanity check, not a new method or generalized bronze completion score

protocol.limitation: Nested same-object holes; different missing regions can overlap. No exact heldout mask copied. Not new objects or disjoint surface regions.
